about_the_game:
Available as part of the Lost Colony Expansion Pass!

Introducing the latest addition to the ARK Fantastic Tame series! These enchanting diminutive dragons have remarkable adaptability, acting as both steadfast shoulder pets and versatile tools for Survivors.

Drakelings, in their four distinct seasonal variations, each bring distinct-yet-significant advantages to those they bond with.

  • The Spring Drakeling, a creature embodying the season of renewal that invigorates both Survivor and mount with a gentle surge of life, enhancing their resilience and swiftness.

  • The Summer Drakeling, touched by the warmth of the season, offers a valuable resistance against debilitating effects, allowing for greater control in perilous encounters.

  • The Autumnal Drakeling, embodying the bounty of fall, subtly enhances the yield of gathered resources while providing a remarkable adaptability to diverse climates.

  • The Wintery Drakeling, with its frosty aura, offers a tangible reduction in incoming threats and a controlled descent from great heights.

Beyond their individual seasonal aspects, all Drakelings exhibit an affinity for survival, aiding in the discovery of essential supplies and treasures, while offering controlled-descent when falling from heights. Drakelings can also be wielded in combat, enhancing the reach of their breath. Each seasonal variant can project its core essence onto allies, offering tactical support.

Seeking out and befriending all four seasonal Drakelings unlocks their full potential. Whether providing passive enhancements, active combat support, or unique utility, these friendly miniature dragons are a distinctive and valuable addition to a Survivor's capabilities in the expanding worlds of ARK.
